title: Mirrors That Confess
text:
Metafiction has long challenged the idea that a novel should be a faithful mirror of reality. Instead of hiding its construction, it draws attention to the act of writing itself. Readers may find themselves interrupted by narrators who confess their doubts or admit that they are inventing events.

Some scholars consider this technique a response to a world saturated with information, where no single account seems entirely trustworthy. By exposing its own fictionality, the text suggests that understanding is always partial. Yet the effect is not despair; many readers find liberation in acknowledging that meaning is something they must create together with the author.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, which figures sometimes interrupt the reader?
options: Maps that guide them through a city
Footnotes written in a foreign language

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do some scholars consider the technique to be?
options: A response to a world saturated with information

questions.text: What does the passage imply about the reliability of a single account in an information-saturated world?
options: It is always the most accurate source
It is preferred by most readers
It has become impossible to write

questions.text: What can be inferred about the readers' attitude toward this kind of fiction by the end of the passage?
options: They reject any role in creating meaning
They prefer traditional mirrors of reality

filled completely with something, so that no more can be added
the feeling or act of being freed from a restriction

paragraph_translations: Metakurgu, uzun zamandır bir romanın gerçekliğin sadık bir aynası olması gerektiği fikrine meydan okumaktadır. Kendi inşasını gizlemek yerine, yazma eyleminin kendisine dikkat çeker. Okurlar, şüphelerini itiraf eden ya da olayları uydurduklarını kabul eden anlatıcılar tarafından kesintiye uğratıldıklarını görebilir.

Bazı akademisyenler bu tekniği, tek bir anlatımın tamamen güvenilir görünmediği, bilgiyle doymuş bir dünyaya verilen bir yanıt olarak görmektedir. Metin, kendi kurgusallığını açığa vurarak anlamanın her zaman kısmi olduğunu ima eder. Yine de etki umutsuzluk değildir; birçok okur, anlamın yazarla birlikte yaratılması gereken bir şey olduğunu kabul ederek özgürleşme bulur.
